parameters.description: Test case statuses to keep, e.g. `status=failed&status=error` for every test that needs fixing (a comma-separated list also works). A test that failed and then passed on a retry has status `passed` and `flaky` true.
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Only return test cases under the test suite with this exact name, at any nesting level.
parameters.name: suite

parameters.description: Only return test cases with this exact class name.
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.description: Only return test cases that are (true) or are not (false) flaky in this build. A test case is flaky when its runs ended with different statuses.
parameters.name: flaky

parameters.description: Sort the test cases within each test suite. Ascending `status` lists `error`, `failed`, `skipped`, then `passed`.
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.description: Direction of `sort_by`. Only valid together with `sort_by`.
parameters.name: sort_order

parameters.description: Maximum number of test cases to return, counted in response order across all test suites.
parameters.name: limit
